title: Utopia Bedding Throw Pillows Insert (Pack of 2, White) - 18 x 18 Inches Bed and Couch Pillows - Indoor Decorative Pillows

reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: Pillow is vacuum packed. I’ve not used it yet. But the feel is soft and comfy.
reviews.author: Jessy L.

reviews.title: FULL and SOFT
reviews.body: These pillows are really nice. They are full and soft.  Can stuff in a cover or use as is.  Color is exactly as pictured.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 9 September 2025
reviews.author: CMD

reviews.title: Plump with no lumps
reviews.body: These cushion inserts arrived quickly and when opened expanded rapidly. No need to put them in the dryer! In fact they expanded so much I didn't think they would fit inside the cushion covers but they did and with no lumps just very plump. Really very good, much better than expected.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 13 June 2021
reviews.author: Mma

reviews.title: Great Pillows
reviews.body: Standard white pillows. Arrived decompressed which made storing much easier until the covers arrived. We’re very easy to fluff up and fit there covers very nicely
reviews.author: Jordan Bayne

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.body: Arrived firm and look to be good quality.
reviews.author: Catherine

features: SQUARE PILLOW PACK - Pack of 2 decorative square pillows for your couches or bedroom; they are neither too big nor too small and they give off a homely vibe
PACKAGING - Pillows are compressed in vacuum packaging because of shipping purpose, they might appear as one large pillow.
DIMENSIONS - Each square pillow measures 18 by 18 inches
FIBER FILLING – Soft outer shell and siliconised fiber filling will never make them look hollow
SOFT AND DURABLE - The pillows are designed to give a delicate feel while retaining long term durability.CARE INSTRUCTIONS - It is recommended to spot clean the pillow or hand wash the fabric
